notablePrerequisites: Lingering Tormentor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lingering Tormentor, adding {C}{C}.
Lingering Tormentor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lingering Tormentor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
